# 第三方项目

**不要把第三方 GitHub 仓库直接复制进本项目启动包。**

优先：
- 使用官方 Python 包 / API / CLI；
- 必要时使用 Docker 服务；
- 在 README/依赖文件里声明版本。

参考项目：

- Qwen-Agent: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Agent
- LangGraph: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph
- BioMCP: https://github.com/genomoncology/biomcp
- GDC Client: https://github.com/NCI-GDC/gdc-client
- GEOparse: https://github.com/guma44/GEOparse
- cBioPortal Datahub: https://github.com/cBioPortal/datahub
- cBioPortal Curation Tools: https://github.com/cBioPortal/datahub-study-curation-tools
- scispaCy: https://github.com/allenai/scispacy
- OncoTree: https://github.com/cBioPortal/oncotree
- DuckDB: https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb
- Pandera: https://github.com/unionai-oss/pandera
- Label Studio: https://github.com/HumanSignal/label-studio
- DVC: https://github.com/iterative/dvc
